topic: Red Wings Travel Assistant: primary-source analogs and narrow demonstration MVP
method: Current web search and text fetch of official help pages, product pages, press releases and API documentation. No browser interaction, authenticated transport API calls or purchases.
evidence_boundary: Confirmed means documented on the cited primary page, not independently exercised end to end. Search crawls and text fetches are not evidence of date-specific bookable inventory. Proposed UX, ranking, tool names and demonstration scenarios are design recommendations.

demonstration_scenarios.candidate_topology: Екатеринбург городской узел → SVX → RW → GOJ → конкретный ж/д вокзал Нижнего Новгорода → Владимир
candidate_variants: Public transport to station plus rail
Taxi to station plus a feasible rail departure
Road transfer from GOJ only if sourced
demonstration_scenarios.fallback: Explicit no-RW-in-covered-results or no-data state; never invent future WZ 5029 recurrence

demonstration_scenarios.input: Already selected/bought Самара → Екатеринбург RW flight, actual date and local times supplied by user; continue to Нижний Тагил
demonstration_scenarios.observed_route_anchor: WZ 1034 observed on the official board for 2026-11-13; not automatically reused on another date
candidate_variants: Koltsovo to railway station plus train
Koltsovo to specific bus station plus bus
must_check_before_positive_demo: Exact locked flight date, airport and times
Ground transfer and actual onward departure
demonstration_scenarios.fallback: Keep locked flight; show unconfirmed ground section. Historical data must be visibly labelled.

controlled_responses: Successful empty RW response within a declared limited demonstration dataset
Transport-source timeout for the same request
Optional RW segment found but transfer or price missing
demonstration_scenarios.expected: Distinct empty-result, unavailable-source and incomplete-chain states; no generated flights, missing transfers or zero prices
does_not_establish: That RW does not serve either city
That no real-world RW-containing path exists

research_limitations: No date-specific tickets or complete multimodal chains were verified end to end.
Ground transfer times, station-to-airport paths and taxi quotes remain to be supplied for positive cards.
A timetable page or a route landing page is not proof of inventory.
Actual deep-link parameters for RW booking and transport sellers were not validated; retain sourced URLs and label their type.
API numerical quota, account access and deployment reachability were not established.
No guarantee of protected separately issued tickets is proposed.
